In [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Sant|mythology]], '''Uuru''' was the [[Water/Legends|water]] goddess and the sister of [[Quay (deity)|Quay]]. [[Gender/Legends|She]] helped to watch over the prison of [[Quay'va]].<ref name="LoNH" />

[[Bandigo]]s, dangerous animals found in [[Temptation Canyon]], were believed to be Uuru's servants.<ref name="LoNH" />
